scope: One nominal acquisition in the existing scene using the existing strict vision approach and protected review stop. Optical development only: neither truth nor this reader can authorize a new motion.
print: All thirteen material rows have distinct full-triangle lane codes. Left station is column 9 and right station is column 14. No new faces, geometry, shrinkage or constraint changes. The two central lanes only witness surviving material; they do not seed either retained bank. The palette is entirely inside the native pink mask, separated from the stock band red and the marker-sphere palette. The diagnostic mask explicitly unions the exact codes with the normal sheet mask. The original unprinted RGB-D is restored byte-identically before the controller sees the next frame.
capture: At the same actuation checkpoints as v4: loaded pre-cut ALIGN, each guarded closed-jaw post-bite back-off, and the single real ECM endpoint review before any next opening. In each snapshot use the same native exposure for print, measured range and the three-marker/fixed-depth gate. Log tick, simulation time, camera pose, true intrinsics and depth/RGB bytes digest. Preserve the old controller's mechanical and sweep interlocks, and always fail closed at the review in this version.
decision: Report decoded left/right station counts, same-exposure tip gate, local aperture and visible central material separately. A local 8/9/10 ordinal is not a structural prefix. Record consecutive positive visible open rows starting at the entry only, with no later positive opening or contradictory central face. Row zero has no entry boundary proof in this reader, so no connected-prefix candidate can currently be asserted. Missing ink and missing background are not evidence. The diagnostic does not gate on the legacy scalar progress; changing production terminal authority requires both a witnessed causal prefix and independent scoring, not a successful local read or extra closures.
